Subject: Re: Onboarding forms submitted — need Purchase ID

Hi Diego,

Thanks again — we uploaded the onboarding packet for CedarCloud (SOW + tax docs) via the vendor portal this morning, but our finance team is blocked without a Purchase ID. The portal shows the ledger items were created, but there are two orphaned SKU lines (SKU-CED-1001, SKU-CED-1001-ADD) that are preventing PO assignment.

Can procurement help:
- get a provisional Purchase ID so we can accept the staging credits?
- confirm or raise the initial spend fence (we requested $75k but the portal defaulted to $0)
- advise if you need any corrected line descriptions or a revised SOW — I attached the onboarding_form.pdf to this message.

Appreciate a quick turn — our staging window opens Monday.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Finance, CedarCloud
M: +1 415 555 0199

Hi Marta — thanks for the heads up and for uploading the packet. Looping in Monica and Marcus from procurement to triage the orphaned lines and do a provisional PO.

Quick ask for the procurement team: can you confirm the intended mapping for the two SKUs? Marta indicates SKU-CED-1001 is the base license and SKU-CED-1001-ADD is onboarding services (one-time). If procurement needs an updated line description or quantity, please advise so Marta can resubmit the SOW.

Next steps:
- Monica: please check the ledger routing and spend fence.
- Marcus: if possible assign a provisional Purchase ID or tell us the blocking validation.

Marta — Ill keep you posted here.

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 12:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding forms submitted — need Purchase ID

Diego / Marcus / Marta,

I pulled the ledger and the vendor intake record. Summary of findings:
- Two ledger lines were created but not binding to a purchase-ref due to a SKU normalization mismatch (suffix -ADD not recognized by the mapping rules).
- Portal defaulted spend fence to $0 because the onboarding workflow didn't flag the request field (we see the requested amount in the SOW but it wasn't persisted).

To remediate we need:
1) Confirm final line descriptions/qtys (see below). If CedarCloud confirms, we will patch the line items.
2) Confirm desired provisional spend cap (Marta requested $75,000).
3) Provide the internal cost-center code to map (for ledger tagging).

Proposed normalized lines:
- SKU-CED-1001 — CedarCloud Platform license — Qty 1 — Unit price $50,000
- SKU-CED-1001-ONBOARD — CedarCloud Onboarding Services — Qty 1 — Unit price $25,000

If CedarCloud confirms items and spend cap, we can issue a provisional Purchase ID (temp) and push the line corrections. Ill also prepare the lineitem_snapshot.csv so Marcus can sign off.

Monica
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@cedarcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding forms submitted — need Purchase ID

Thanks Monica — CedarCloud confirmed the line descriptions by phone. Ive done the following:

- Issued provisional Purchase ID: RF-2026-3462 (provisional; will be converted when PO receipts are finalized).
- Set provisional spend fence to $75,000 effective immediately.
- Patched ledger lines to match proposed normalized SKUs (see attached lineitem_snapshot.csv). Two orphaned lines reconciled and re-linked to RF-2026-3462.
- Attached a short confirmation file (procurement_provisional_po_confirm.txt) with routing codes.

Action items for CedarCloud:
- Please return the signed onboarding form (Ive included a DocuSign link for convenience) or attach a signed PDF to this thread.
- Finance please confirm internal cost-center is CC-3312 so our ledger tag matches. If different, reply and well update.

DocuSign link (sign onboarding): https://docusign.example.com/embedded?doc=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/9082

Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Marcus / Monica / Diego,

Received — thank you. Confirming:
- We accept provisional Purchase ID RF-2026-3462.
- Spend fence $75,000 is fine.
- Cost center is CC-3312 (confirmed).

Ive signed the onboarding form via the DocuSign link and attached the signed PDF (cedar_onboarding_form_signed.pdf). Please let us know when the provisional PO shows in the portal so our finance team can proceed with staging credits.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Marta
